| **Time to first review** | *(pending)* | |
| **Time to acceptance (total)** | First round ~4.4 months / ~19 weeks; total handling to decision ~6.3 months / ~27.3 weeks (SciRev aggregate, small n). One extreme outlier report: a 2011 submission logged 364 days to an immediate rejection. SEPARATELY, and arguably more decision-relevant: per the journal's own editor (Philipp Blum) in a Feb-2024 Daily Nous piece, dialectica accepted papers continuously through issue 76(4) (autumn 2023) but had only actually PUBLISHED through 2020 at that point — i.e., a multi-year gap opened up between acceptance and publication during the 2020 Wiley-to-open-access migration, which the editors were still catching up on ("12 issues over two months") as of early 2024. This acceptance-to-publication backlog is a distinct risk from review speed and is not captured by SciRev's numbers. | WO2 research (see sources below); may be a range/qualitative note, not a precise figure |

**Current positioning (WO2, what the journal accepts now):** CRITICAL CURRENT-STATUS FACT (verified 2026-07-13 by direct browser load of https://dialectica.philosophie.ch/, which redirects to philosophie.ch's "Under Construction" page): "Dialectica is undergoing a restructuring with a new editorial team. Submissions are therefore temporarily closed. We anticipate reopening for new submissions in the coming months." The page also confirms publisher history: Wiley-Blackwell 2004-2019, then self-published open-access via Philosophie.ch 2020-2024 (note the site's own wording implies the 2020-2024 arrangement itself has ended, consistent with the ongoing restructuring). So as of today the journal is NOT accepting new submissions at all — this must be flagged prominently in any journal-match recommendation.

**Methods noted as welcome (WO2, qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** General analytic/theoretical/systematic philosophy, any topic, any length — the journal is deliberately broad-scope ("the mutual support between science and philosophy"), Discussion pieces responding to prior work (own or others'), if of broader significance

### Reviewer Pool Characteristics

SciRev respondents rated review-report quality 4.0/5 and rated the review commentary as easy to act on (2.0/5 on a difficulty scale, i.e. low difficulty); overall handling experience rated 4.0/5 ("very good"). No Chinese-language first-hand submission accounts were found (see cross_language_checked) so no cross-cultural reviewer-culture claim can be made beyond this English-language SciRev signal.

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **ai_policy (entire layer)**: dialectica has not been published by Wiley since 2020 and is now independently run; its own site is currently an "Under Construction" placeholder with submissions closed, so no journal-specific AI/LLM-use, authorship, or disclosure policy page is publicly reachable as of 2026-07-13. Did not substitute Wiley's generic (and no-longer-applicable) 2023 AI policy.
- **preprint.allowed**: No explicit preprint/self-archiving policy statement was found in any reachable source (journal site inaccessible; DOAJ/Sherpa-Romeo not checked successfully). The journal is CC-BY platinum OA with no APC, which often correlates with preprint-friendliness, but that is an inference, not a stated fact, so left null rather than asserted.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture (cross-language dimension)**: 小木虫 muchong.com and 知乎 zhihu searches returned only general reputation/history commentary (e.g. discussion of a famous blank-page paper meme) with zero first-hand submission/review-experience reports; fabiaoji.com results surfaced only generic paid journal-directory listings, not user reviews of dialectica specifically; Reddit r/AskAcademia search returned zero dialectica-specific threads.
